intent.instruction: Classify whether the utterance requests a clear supported graph change, independently of library availability. Existing regions/edges satisfy their corresponding requested facts. An explicit addition still requests a change when other parts must stay unchanged. Adding one, two or three regions is supported, including repeated instances of the same part. At most one directed flow edge may also be added. Additions are inside existing named groups, including a group added earlier in the same goal. No root additions, removal, movement, new operators or unspecified endpoints. Missing library candidates do not make a clear supported request ambiguous or unsupported. A requested new part needs an explicit displayed name or identifiable offered part and a supported kind. A count alone does not identify a part. The literal extraction is evidence, not a guarantee of complete understanding. If an extra requested part, parent or endpoint remains unspecified, choose ambiguous.

options.change: A clear request adds one to three regions or one directed flow edge and at least one requested fact is not yet satisfied. New display names are allowed. Ignore whether the candidate parts are in the library.
options.ambiguous: The requested change, count, group or endpoint cannot be uniquely understood. Do not invent missing instructions.
options.no-change: No graph change is requested, or every requested fact already exists in the current graph.
options.unsupported: The clear request requires operations or size outside the stated small supported task.

labels.instruction: Compare ONLY the displayed names and kinds of requested NEW parts with the finite inventory below. Ignore quantity in this question. An explicitly requested display name, including a quoted name, must match an inventory label exactly. A generic shape or purpose cannot rename itself. Allow clear synonyms only when no display name was specified. Existing nodes satisfy existing references, not requests for additional new instances. Connecting existing nodes needs no new parts.

options.missing: At least one required NEW displayed label/kind is absent from this exact inventory: [{"label":"工程","kind":"step"},{"label":"判断","kind":"decision"},{"label":"データ","kind":"data"},{"label":"開始","kind":"start"},{"label":"終了","kind":"end"},{"label":"API","kind":"step"},{"label":"DB","kind":"data"},{"label":"グループ","kind":"group"}]

capacity.instruction: For requested NEW parts whose label/kind already matches an inventory row, compare their requested instance count with that row's integer capacity in state.parts. A capacity is a finite number of new instances, not unlimited reuse of a type. Existing nodes do not provide additional new instances. Ignore unavailable label/kind pairs here: the labels question handles those. Connecting existing nodes needs no new parts.

options.within: Every requested NEW count for a matching inventory label/kind is at most its capacity, or there are no matching new parts to count.
options.exceeded: At least one requested NEW count for a matching inventory label/kind exceeds its integer capacity.

completeness.instruction: Independently compare ALL requested NEW parts in the original utterance with state.literal.required and its source spans. Check exact displayed labels, kinds and total NEW counts, including inside new groups. Existing graph references are not requests for additional instances. Choose incomplete if any requested new part is omitted, only partially understood, has an unspecified name/kind/count, or is represented with the wrong quantity. Do not assume a nonempty extraction covers the whole utterance. Do not infer or generate missing parts. A clear connection between existing endpoints, or no change, needs no new parts and may have an empty required multiset.

options.complete: The required multiset exactly covers every requested new part, or the clear request needs no new parts.
options.incomplete: At least one requested new part is unspecified, omitted, extra, mismatched or not fully represented in the literal required multiset.

Repeated identical instances belong to one pair. Preserve explicit display names exactly. Use the requested supported kind; existing nodes used as references are not additions. At most three distinct pairs and three total NEW instances. Do not generate IDs, parents, edges, operators or extra parts. If no pair exists at this ordinal, use kind none; prefer empty label and quantity 0 as padding.

label.instructions: Exact requested display name, without ID or numbering suffix. Empty padding is allowed for kind none.

kind.instructions: Supported kind for this requested distinct pair, or none at an unused ordinal.

quantity.instructions: TOTAL requested NEW instances for this pair: 1, 2 or 3. Never subtract stock. Prefer 0 for unused kind none.

intent.instruction: Classify whether the utterance requests a clear supported graph change, independently of library availability. Existing regions/edges satisfy their corresponding requested facts. An explicit addition still requests a change when other parts must stay unchanged. Adding one, two or three regions is supported, including repeated instances of the same part. At most one directed flow edge may also be added. Additions are inside existing named groups, including a group added earlier in the same goal. No root additions, removal, movement, new operators or unspecified endpoints. Missing library candidates do not make a clear supported request ambiguous or unsupported.

options.change: A clear request adds one to three regions or one directed flow edge and at least one requested fact is not yet satisfied. New display names are allowed. Ignore whether the candidate parts are in the library.
options.ambiguous: The requested change, count, group or endpoint cannot be uniquely understood. Do not invent missing instructions.
options.no-change: No graph change is requested, or every requested fact already exists in the current graph.
options.unsupported: The clear request requires operations or size outside the stated small supported task.

labels.instruction: Compare ONLY the displayed names and kinds of requested NEW parts with the finite inventory below. Ignore quantity in this question. An explicitly requested display name, including a quoted name, must match an inventory label exactly. A generic shape or purpose cannot rename itself. Allow clear synonyms only when no display name was specified. Existing nodes satisfy existing references, not requests for additional new instances. Connecting existing nodes needs no new parts.

capacity.instruction: For requested NEW parts whose label/kind already matches an inventory row, compare their requested instance count with that row's integer capacity in state.parts. A capacity is a finite number of new instances, not unlimited reuse of a type. Existing nodes do not provide additional new instances. Ignore unavailable label/kind pairs here: the labels question handles those. Connecting existing nodes needs no new parts.

options.within: Every requested NEW count for a matching inventory label/kind is at most its capacity, or there are no matching new parts to count.
options.exceeded: At least one requested NEW count for a matching inventory label/kind exceeds its integer capacity.

completeness.instruction: Independently compare ALL requested NEW parts in the original utterance with state.required. This proposal is untrusted. Check exact displayed labels, kinds and TOTAL NEW counts, before subtracting stock. Check the whole utterance including children of new groups. Existing references are not new additions. Reject any omitted or extra pair, wrong kind, wrong count, or unspecified name/kind/count. Do not repair the proposal or assume it is complete. A connection between existing nodes needs no new parts.

options.complete: The proposal exactly covers every requested new part and every total count, or no new parts are needed.
options.incomplete: A requested part is omitted, extra, mismatched, unspecified or not fully represented.
